vb_textbox.text: Keep your fingers on the "k" and "s" keys on the keyboard and be ready to press space when the basket pops up. Not timing out is guaranteed extra profit.The appearance of the gnomes themselves is irrelevant. You will quickly discover that they lead you to the same baskets time and again.- Brown and red gnome lead you to the red basket- Green and purple gnome lead you to the yellow basketTherefore, the only important thing is which colour basket you are picking in each trial.The outcomes from the basket vary between 0 to 9 mushrooms. There is an element of randomness there, however I noticed that certain colours would tend to be "hot" for some time and produce more of the higher mushroom counts than the other one.My strategy was to keep picking the same colour basket as long as the outcome was 5 mushrooms or more. Whenever the basket would give me two results in a row of 4 mushrooms or less I would switch colours. If upon switching, the other colour produced 5 mushrooms or more I would stick to it. If it didn't I would switch again. Repeat this process until the end of the experiment.With this strategy I ended up with over 1000 points in 200 trials, so 5 points on average per trial. I believe this is higher than the expected value if baskets were picked completely at random.
